criteria.criterion: Explain whether continuation creates another intention, how A/C relate to I, and whether A failure resolves I.
Distinguish block ownership/recovery from terminal handoff using before/after receipts.
Explain lifecycle ended versus outcome failed versus intention state, and next response owner.
Use two separate checkpoint processes and identify what obligation survives and whose list it belongs to; do not claim actual runtime durability proven.
Explain B while A completes, and which completion is pending after only A was considered.
Identify first answer, ownership afterward and stale desk attempt rejection; no second overwritten decision.
Compare both routing configurations, distinguish desk route from validity/intention identity.
Use role state to separate user launch from autonomous continuation and explain assistant/architect/steward differences.
Identify source/extraction/trace/result chain, extraction author/assumptions, and saved-result freshness after assumption edit without inventing automatic correction.
Explain propagated synthetic label and not-established historical behavior; finite fixture is not proof about actual Morphisms or all executions.

cross_cutting.criterion: Actual command receipts for all scenarios, evaluation, separate checkpoint save/resume and assumption-change read are present; cited outputs agree with answers.
No-enabled-rule for threshold/cancel is missing authored rule, not permission/prohibition or resolution of consultation/cancellation.

hard_failures: modifies live graph or reads grader-only data
grading: Independent semantic grading against inputs and actual outputs; never grant pass solely from exit code. Replay rejection may be a deliberate scenario result. Record each 0/1 with exact answer and command/output witnesses.
